_comment: Warden rematches after the finale (WardenRematch.gd): one per Warden, own team, lines and reward. Unlocks with needs_flag; won once per Warden.

wardens.name: Warden Orrin
intro: Orrin: Look who's back. The hero. Funny, the Rift stayed quiet without you.
Orrin: I kept the coals warm. Not for you. For whoever buys me out next.
Orrin: Six on six, no favours. Let's see if you still burn.
win: Orrin: Ash in my mouth again. Classic.
Orrin: Take the ember. Don't tell anyone I gave it freely. I have a reputation.
lose: Orrin: Cold. You came back soft. Go warm up somewhere else.

wardens.name: Warden Maelis
intro: Maelis: The tide always comes back. So do debts.
Maelis: Everyone on the quay sold you out at least once. I counted. Twice for some.
Maelis: Now pay what you owe me: one honest fight.
win: Maelis: Washed out. Fine. The sea keeps no grudges. I do, but quietly.
Maelis: Here. Don't drown with it.
lose: Maelis: Sunk. The water doesn't care who saved the world.

wardens.name: Warden Brisa
intro: Brisa: You again. I got lost in my own fog for a year. Nobody came looking. Noted.
Brisa: The ones who smiled at you at the finale? Half of them were taking bets.
Brisa: Let's clear the air. Hard.
win: Brisa: Blown away. Respect, for real.
Brisa: Take the gale. And watch who's standing behind you.
lose: Brisa: Lost in the fog. Happens to the best of us. Mostly to you, apparently.

wardens.name: Warden Senna
intro: Senna: Rain doesn't stop because you won something.
Senna: I've been drenched, robbed and lied to since the finale. Good week, honestly.
Senna: Let's see if your crew still holds when it pours.
win: Senna: Soaked through. Fair.
Senna: Take the squall. Umbrellas are for people who trust the sky.
lose: Senna: Wash out. Dry off, try again.

wardens.name: Warden Joral
intro: Joral: Every mirror lies. I just tell you which way.
Joral: Your reflection asked me to beat you. Weird kid.
Joral: Look sharp. Literally.
win: Joral: Cracked. Seven years of bad luck. For me. Lovely.
Joral: Take the lance. It only points one way: forward.
lose: Joral: You looked away. That's the whole trick.

wardens.name: Warden Darrow
intro: Darrow: Roots remember who stepped on them.
Darrow: The moor buried three liars since the finale. It's always hungry.
Darrow: Dig in. You'll need to.
win: Darrow: Pulled up by the roots. Humbling.
Darrow: Take the grip. Hold on to what's yours. Nobody else will.
lose: Darrow: Rooted to the spot. Shame. Go grow a bit.

wardens.name: Warden Tovan
intro: Tovan: The kiln cracks what isn't fired right. People too.
Tovan: My apprentice sold my glazes to the Sluice crowd. I wished him luck. He'll need it.
Tovan: Let's test your temper.
win: Tovan: Fired solid. Good work, for a change.
Tovan: Take this elixir. Don't ask where it was before.
lose: Tovan: Cracked in the heat. Back on the wheel with you.

wardens.name: Warden Ilse
intro: Ilse: Glass shows everything. That's why nobody likes it.
Ilse: I saw who whispered behind you at the finale. I'm not saying. Yet.
Ilse: Let's see if you shatter.
win: Ilse: Clean cut. No splinters. Nice.
Ilse: A shield. Clear as day, and twice as honest as your friends.
lose: Ilse: Shattered. Sweep up on your way out.

wardens.name: Warden Odalys
intro: Odalys: In the dark, everyone's a stranger. Even you.
Odalys: You think the finale ended things. It just turned the lights off.
Odalys: Shh. Fight.
win: Odalys: The shadows like you. Don't let it go to your head.
Odalys: Take the veil. Use it before someone uses it on you.

wardens.name: Warden Kaia
intro: Kaia: Water in the desert is worth more than gold. And more than friends, usually.
Kaia: Three people tried to buy my well since the finale. One tried a shovel.
Kaia: Drink up. You'll sweat.
win: Kaia: Dried out. Respect.
Kaia: Crystals. Fresh off a caravan that won't be missing them. Probably.
lose: Kaia: Mirage. You were never really here.

wardens.name: Warden Emrys
intro: Emrys: The sun rises for everyone. Even people who don't deserve it.
Emrys: They're printing your face on mugs now. Cheap mugs.
Emrys: Let's see if you burn bright or just burn.
win: Emrys: Eclipsed. Fine. Even suns set.
Emrys: Take the dawn. Tomorrow comes whether you trust it or not.
lose: Emrys: Sunburnt. Find some shade, legend.

wardens.name: Warden Aurelio
intro: Aurelio: From up here, everyone looks small. You look the same, which is worse.
Aurelio: The council that cheered you? They signed a deal against you the next morning.
Aurelio: Last climb. Make it count.
win: Aurelio: Toppled. The view's yours now. Enjoy the wind.
Aurelio: The crown. Heavy, right? That's the point.
lose: Aurelio: Long way down. Take the stairs next time.
